 Follow DJ John Summit Slams the Grammys for Ignoring ‘Real Electronic Dance Music,’ Vows to Stop Submitting
 Kim Brown Updated Mon, November 16, 2026 at 3:00 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Getty Images DJ John Summit is calling out the Grammy Awards after seeing the nominations for the 2027 show. 
 The 32-year-old revealed he'll never submit for the awards show again unless things change, citing "zero respect for real electronic dance music & dj's."
 DJ John Summit Called Out the Recording Academy
 As the Grammy nominations were being announced this morning, he posted his thoughts on X .
 John shared, "never submitting to the grammys again unless **** changes, it's all a ******* joke. i'm not just talking about myself either there's zero respect for real electronic dance music & dj's. the whole dance category is just music industry fueled pop stars."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Some of the artists nominated in the dance/electronic categories include Madonna, Tinashe, and Slayyyter .
 John Summit Then Clarified His Stance About Who Was Nominated
 He continued, "not saying the artists nominated aren't good, they're just not dance music, they're pop. no dj is playing that music in the clubs. here come all the lil teeny bopper pop stan accounts with zero real world life experience to attack me."
 See the full list of Grammy Awards nominations for the 2027 show.
